title: Time-parametric Gerstner Wave Engine for Digital Craft
description: Grasshopper and GhPython definitions for a generative wave-surface system that bridges computational design with physical fabrication. The engine extends the classical Gerstner wave equation with multi-octave layering distributed by the golden angle, domain warping, and a continuous time variable t treated as an independent design variable rather than a playback control. Supplementary material for the SIGraDi 2026 paper "Algorithmic Waves and Physical Moiré: Time-parametric Generative Design and the Dialectic of Digital Craftsmanship".
